dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

3 پرامپت آماده برای رزومه 👇
اول شماره، آدرس و ایمیلت رو از متن حذف کن:

1. غلط‌گیری بدون دست بردن در محتوا:
"Act as a recruiter in [field]. List the spelling, grammar and clarity problems in my CV below and suggest fixes. Do not add any skill or fact that is not in my text. [CV]"
2. وظیفه به دستاورد:
"Rewrite these bullet points as achievements: action verb + result. Use only facts I gave. Where a number is missing, write [number?] instead of inventing one. [bullets]"
3. هماهنگ با آگهی:
"Here is a job ad and my CV. List the 5 key skills in the ad, show which ones my CV already proves, and suggest wording changes using only my real experience. [ad] [CV]"

پژوهش: nber.org/papers/w30886
